instructions.fingerprint_update: Run sha256sum (Linux/macOS) or certutil -hashfile (Windows) against the local Dropbox copy, then replace the 'PENDING' value with the 40-char hex digest. Never store the file content itself in this repo.
instructions.add_seed: Append a new entry to 'seeds[]'. Assign a unique 'id'. Register the corresponding source in 08_sources/sources.manifest.yaml. Set ingest_status to 'registered' until fingerprint is confirmed.
instructions.deprecate_seed: Set 'ingest_status' to 'deprecated' and add a 'deprecated_at' field. Do not delete the entry.
